source.quote: RME ADI-2 DAC FS product page and user's guide, read 2026-11-20: USB class compliant to 768 kHz with DSD playback. The two S/PDIF inputs are NOT recorded: the guide describes the device as a 768 kHz converter without stating a per-input ceiling, and asserting 768 kHz on an optical input on that basis would be extraordinary. They fall through to the catalogue's conservative defaults, which is the honest answer here.
